findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is 81c0e89c4fe9169ce63945bf329e72de15027bac439f2fbda002a2d5804905d4; all 5 declared sources passed current HTTPS access review.

Five current official Texas RRC and Texas State Library pages support the bounded claim-to-source map. The RRC stub identifier, PDQ scope and lag, automated-access boundary, and county deed/probate research roles are not extended into ownership conclusions.
No actual owner, statement, payor, county, tract, decimal, legal description, price, or value was provided; the worked example is fictional and explicitly unresolved.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Royalties FAQ (accessed 2026-09-17)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The RRC royalties FAQ distinguishes a payor stub identifier from an RRC identifier and describes qualified requests for lease, property, or well identifiers.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: It does not prove a particular heir owns an interest, that an old payor reference maps perfectly to a current RRC record, or that every statement has the same fields.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Production Data Query System FAQ (accessed 2026-09-17)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The RRC PDQ FAQ describes lease, field, operator, district and county search routes, reporting lag and revision, and possible multi-county scope.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: Operator-reported production is contextual, not an owner payment ledger, private title record, or proof of a payor-to-property match.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Research Queries and automated-access boundary (accessed 2026-09-17)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official RRC Research Queries directory provides the manual access route and its automated-use warning.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article does not automate or encourage bulk retrieval from restricted RRC queries.

sources_inspected.label: Texas State Library and Archives Commission, Land and Property History Research (accessed 2026-09-17)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: Texas State Library land/property guidance places conveyance research in the county where the land lies.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: A county deed search result does not establish a complete chain of title or heirship.

sources_inspected.label: Texas State Library and Archives Commission, County Records on Microfilm (accessed 2026-09-17)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: Texas State Library county-record guidance distinguishes deed, probate, and will record classes and historical coverage.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: Availability varies; a probate index or one recorded instrument does not resolve a person-specific title question.
